risks.note: BRSR Section A reports Real Estate (including facility management, with owned or leased assets) as the sole business activity at 100% of turnover, and Real Estate Development as the sole product/service at 100% of turnover. There is no second earnings stream to cushion a downturn in the property cycle.
risks.risk: Single-activity concentration - 100% of turnover from real estate

risks.note: The Company states it "has strategically chosen to focus currently on developing multiple asset classes in Delhi NCR", with exports not applicable and registered/corporate offices only in Noida (UP), Okhla (New Delhi) and Gurugram (Haryana). Regulatory, approval, infrastructure or demand shocks specific to the NCR micro-markets hit the entire portfolio at once.

Flagged as a Risk in the BRSR material responsible business conduct issues table: "Non-compliance with environmental regulations can result in penalties, legal consequences, and reputational harm", with negative financial implications of potential fines, legal costs and reputational damage. Mitigation is an environmental management system, adherence to regulations, monitoring and reporting, and a zero-tolerance policy on non-compliance.

Flagged as a Risk in the BRSR material issues table, citing increasing climate-related events (floods, heatwaves, thunderstorms, smog situations) - relevant for a business whose construction schedules, site safety and operating assets are exposed to weather and air-quality disruption.

The Board's Report qualifies the projected booking value of more than Rs 3,000 crore from the Base Buildwell (Sector 59, Gurugram) acquisition as "subject to project execution timelines, requisite approvals and market conditions", making a material part of the growth pipeline contingent on regulatory clearance and market absorption.
risks.risk: Execution and approval dependency on new land/SPV acquisitions

risks.note: BRSR transparency disclosures record 1,662 customer complaints filed in FY 2025-26 against 914 in FY 2024-25 (classified as Commercial and Residential, none related to delivery of essential services), all closed with none pending. The near-doubling alongside portfolio scale-up is a service-quality and brand watch-item; Factech Software has been implemented across all commercial operational sites.

Permanent employee turnover was 16% in FY 2025-26 (14% male, 25% female) versus 15% in FY 2024-25 and 18% in FY 2023-24. With women at only 17% of the workforce, the materially higher female attrition rate works against the stated diversity agenda and against retention of a workforce being scaled to support the project pipeline.

A BRSR grievance note records a complaint pertaining to "a legacy matter involving a former shareholder of Pharmax Corporation Limited, a Subsidiary of the Company" - a residual claim carried in through an acquired SPV, illustrating inherited-liability exposure in the acquisition-led growth model.
risks.risk: Legacy shareholder/legal matter at a subsidiary
